استقيما (form X)
# اُسْتُقِيمَا (ustuqīmā) /us.tu.qiː.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَقَامَ (istaqāma)
# اِسْتَقِيمَا (istaqīmā) /is.ta.qiː.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَقَامَ (istaqāma)
